subject.title: feat: optional info lines (IP, uptime, OS, location) on the name tag

question: Should Nameplate support opt-in persistent IP, uptime, OS-version, and fleet-location lines on the name tag, shipping the user-facing implementation on macOS first?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and proven, but persistent network/location visibility and platform-specific rollout are product choices not established by current behavior or repository policy.

options.title: Sponsor the full feature
options.body: Accept all four default-off fields on macOS and treat equivalent Windows/Linux behavior as later parity work.

options.title: Start with lower-sensitivity fields
options.body: Land uptime and OS version while deferring IP and fleet location until disclosure and parity expectations are clearer.

options.title: Keep details menu-only
options.body: Decline persistent info lines and retain the existing on-demand system-information presentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full feature
recommendation.body: Accept all four default-off fields on macOS and treat equivalent Windows/Linux behavior as later parity work.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns and recently maintained the central overlay, settings, lifecycle, system-information, and fleet-location paths.
